description: Source code for the PHY driver for KSZ9021RL/RN specifically designed for Cyclone V SoC DevKit, including register definitions, read/write functions, configuration, reset, and speed/duplex retrieval.

methods.name: alt_eth_phy_write_register
methods.description: Writes a value to a PHY register via MDIO interface.

methods.name: alt_eth_phy_read_register
methods.description: Reads a value from a PHY register via MDIO interface.

methods.name: alt_eth_phy_write_register_extended
methods.description: Writes a value to an extended PHY register.

methods.name: alt_eth_phy_read_register_extended
methods.description: Reads a value from an extended PHY register.

methods.name: alt_eth_phy_config
methods.description: Configures PHY settings including auto-negotiation and skew values.

methods.name: alt_eth_phy_get_duplex_and_speed
methods.description: Retrieves current duplex mode and speed from PHY status register.
